_comment: TLDs that are heavily over-represented in phishing relative to their size. A suspicious TLD is weak evidence on its own (LOW severity): most sites on these TLDs are legitimate.
_sources: Spamhaus Project, 'The most abused top-level domains' (spamhaus.org/reputation-statistics/cctlds/domains/), consulted for this list
Interisle Consulting Group, 'Phishing Landscape' annual reports (interisle.net), TLD tables
zip and mov are included because they look like file extensions in link text
